en: Go on, just tell me whatever you need.
Yaaawn... So sleepy.
I dreamed I got in a huge brawl last night.
I was so strong, it was like I wasn't human.
Master, command me as you will...
Dunno why, but I've felt sluggish lately.
A sick beggar? That's no laughing matter.
Pardon me, you fine gentleman there.
I'm Wally, a poor wretched beggar.
Please, spare a little something.
...Take this.
Do you not work?
Heh heh heh, thank you kindly, guv'nor.
Oh, I do work. This here's my job.
Getting folks to give is harder than it looks.
Well then, same again next time. Heh heh.
Won't you spare me something?
Well now, guv'nor. Mornin'.
I'm just off to work myself.
You've got it tough every day too, guv'nor.
Guv'nor, guv'nor, guv'nor! Mornin'.
We're both hale and hearty today. Lucky us.
Health's what matters most for a person.
Heading home from work, good sir?
I'm a poor beggar with no bed for tonight.
So there are beggars even in London.
It's not much, but keep it.
Heh heh heh, thank you kindly.
There's beggars in every town, sir.
Mind you, I'm about the only pro beggar.
Got something for me?
Hey there, guv'nor.
It's me, Wally, the professional beggar.
You've worked hard again today, eh?
I'm about to close up shop myself.
Oh, but if you're giving now, I'll take it.
Evening, guv'nor.
You look busy every day. I used to be, too.
Worked myself silly, I did.
I dreamed of traveling on what I earned.
I wanted to see lands I'd never known.
Now I'm just a beggar, though.
Why, hello there, guv'nor. Good day.
I've got nothing to eat today, see.
And while I'm at it, nowhere to sleep, either.
I'd sure love a little charity.
A beggar, is it... Very well.
note: Follows #152 '...' on the same line: '...A beggar, is it... Very well.'

en: Here. It's not much, but take it.
Thankee, good sir.
Don't forget me, eh? The name's Wally.
I'm always right here.
Well, well, guv'nor, we meet again.
This spot here's my workplace, see.
Lots of passers-by, and shops, too.
You again... Very well.
Thankee as always, good sir.
Don't forget me next time, eh?
Charity's welcome any number of times a day.
Afternoon, guv'nor.
Seeing as you happened by, eh?
Spare me a little something, won't you?
Working the same spot all the time gets dull.
Circus folk and troupers have it good there.
They get to go all sorts of places.
Say, don't you think so too, guv'nor?
Oh, we meet again today! You well, guv'nor?
I'm doing fine too. Look, I got quite a bit.
Next good haul I make, the drinks are on me.
Ahh, I'd love to go somewhere far away.
I'd really like to travel...
Oh, fancy you coming to a place like this.
This is where I sleep. Home sweet home.
That said, I'm still a beggar, y'know.
Spare me something, would you?
Taking handouts here might be a bad idea.
There'd be a scramble for it, see.
Well, well, guv'nor, thanks for the house call.
It's cramped here, so let's meet at the office.
...Don't that sound swanky, put like that?
Oh, guv'nor. Welcome.
